name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC7Raw.gate_phase_all
statement:
theorem gate_phase_all (a : Nat) (t : List Bool) :
    run (8*a+20) ⟨.D, [], false :: pairs a (true :: true :: true :: false :: t)⟩ =
      some ⟨.D, [], false :: pairs (a+4) t⟩
scope: Every natural a and arbitrary finite right tail: raw execution consumes one 1110 block and adds four 10 blocks in 8a+20 defined transitions; zero left half-tape.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC7Raw.gate_sweep_exact_time
statement:
theorem gate_sweep_exact_time (a r : Nat) :
    (∀ t, t < appC7GateSweep a r → ∃ c, run t (gateCfg a r) = some c) ∧
      run (appC7GateSweep a r) (gateCfg a r) = none
scope: Every natural a,r: all prefixes before the recurrence time are defined, and the next attempted instruction halts.

name: CryptidSolvePhase4.AppC7Raw.appC7_raw_gate_exact_time
statement:
theorem appC7_raw_gate_exact_time (b : Nat) :
    (∀ t, t < 16*b*b + 28*b + 15 → ∃ c, run t (initial b) = some c) ∧
      run (16*b*b + 28*b + 15) (initial b) = none
scope: Every natural b for the prefixed A-state family: exact first halting-attempt count 16b²+28b+15; not a blank-tape initial input.
